persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.
bank.Event wording: Neon Night; 12 September 2026; The Foundry, Leeds
bank.Countdown: Show 3, then 2, then 1 before revealing the event details.
bank.Style and pacing: Flashing neon and building electronic beats; hold the final details for at least 3 seconds.
bank.Language and voice: English text, no talking or voiceover.

messages.text: Can you make an ad for Neon Night, please? I’m excited about this and keep picturing how it’ll feel when the event details finally appear. It needs to be 8 seconds long and vertical, and the event is on 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big countdown showing 3, then 2, then 1, with building electronic beats and flashing neon. Then reveal the event name, date and venue, and hold that end card so I can read it. No talking, please.
